title: Color / Secondary colors
slide_intent: Give supporting colors a stated purpose because variety should add expression without obscuring the core identity.
strategic_value: The six vibrant hues can let Duolingo create delight and variety in illustrations, interfaces and backgrounds.
demonstration: Six named swatch cards supply values for Macaw, Cardinal, Bee, Fox, Beetle and Humpback beside a short use statement.
practical_value: Use supporting hues for the source’s stated contexts rather than treating them as competing primary signatures.
